title: Senior Talent Acquisition Associate
description:
**About The Role**
As a senior Talent Acquisition associate at CleverTap, you will play a crucial role in identifying, attracting, and hiring top-tier talent to support our innovative and fast-paced work environment in multiple regions across Engineering and GTM teams across the globe.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Recruit exceptional A-Players to join CleverTap’s rapidly growing Tech and Non tech teams
* Collaborate with Hiring Managers and stakeholders to create the ideal candidate profile
* Develop and refine an interview process that enhances our assessment quality while optimising the candidate experience
* Be a trusted talent acquisition advisor with a strong understanding of the talent pool
* Facilitate a pipeline of strong candidates for future needs
* Implement modern sourcing/recruiting methods
* Lead and/or participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives related to hiring
* Partner with the People team in contributing to the overall employer branding strategy

**What are we looking for?**

* 5-8 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment in technology and Sales hiring, preferably from a Product tech/Saas background
* Experience in hiring for global roles is preferred
* Strong boolean skills and experience with various sourcing platforms and job boards
* Fluency in English
* A high attention to detail
* Flexibility, critical thinking and problem solving skills
* Experience collaborating with Senior Stakeholders and Hiring Managers
* A data driven approach and experience with analytics dashboards
* Ambition, self-motivation and passion for our vision

**Why join us**

* Contribute to a product backed by 11 technology patents, showcasing industry-leading innovation.
* You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high-growth mobile technology space
* Power personalized engagement at scale, processing over 30 billion events daily and reaching 3+ billion devices worldwide.
* Flourish in an environment that nurtures Growth and Curiosity
* Empowering employees with Full-Spectrum Benefits and Assistance

**Learn More**
Get to know us better before you apply!
  
  
Check out our product documentation, engineering blog, and customer stories to see how we work and what we value.
  
  

* CleverAI
* CleverTap Developer Documentation
* Blogs
* TesseractDB™
* CleverTap Product Demo

**About CleverTap**
CleverTap is the world’s leading AI-first, all-in-one customer engagement and retention platform, redefining how brands build lasting customer relationships in the Agentic era. Powered by its proprietary CleverAI™ Decisioning Engine and the Agentic Universe, CleverTap enables autonomous, real-time decision-making that helps organizations deliver 1:1 individualized experiences at scale while maximizing ROI.
  
  
Its unified platform brings together an AI-native Personalization Engine, automated Journey Orchestration, its proprietary Customer Data Platform – TesseractDB™, and deep customer and product analytics to power truly intelligent, self-optimizing engagement across channels including mobile, web, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more. By seamlessly connecting data, insights, and activation, CleverTap ensures every interaction is contextual, coordinated, and conversion-driven.
  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Personalization Engines and a Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™, CleverTap is at the forefront of the shift from campaign-led marketing to agent-led growth. Trusted by more than 2,000 global brands including IKEA, Tesco, Burger King, Levi’s, Decathlon, Domino’s, 7-Eleven, Jio, Grab, Carousell, and Emirates NBD, CleverTap helps businesses drive measurable growth through meaningful, autonomous customer engagement.
  
  
Backed by Accel, Peak XV Partners, Tiger Global, CDPQ, and 360 One, CleverTap has 600+ employees across offices in the US, the Middle East, Asia, and LATAM.
  
  
For more information, visit https://clevertap.com/ or follow us on Linkedin and X.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future of engagement.
  
  
CleverTap is dedicated to establishing an inclusive culture that welcomes individuals from diverse backgrounds, encouraging them to contribute their unique perspectives to our workplace.

Position Purpose
  
  
The IT Talent Acquisition Project Manager is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the end-to-end lifecycle of technical recruitment. Your mission is to build the "engine" that allows us to hire world-class engineers, architects, and data scientists at scale. You will manage high-impact projects ranging from the implementation of new recruitment technologies to the redesign of technical assessment workflows and employer branding initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

* Recruitment Process Engineering
* Workflow Optimization: Lead projects to audit and redesign the technical hiring funnel, reducing "Time-to-Hire" while increasing "Quality-of-Hire."
* Assessment Strategy: Partner with Engineering Leads to implement and manage scalable technical assessment frameworks (e.g., coding platforms, technical interview training, and standardized rubric development).
* Standardization: Drive the creation of global hiring playbooks to ensure a consistent, high-quality candidate experience across all technical departments.
* Talent Technology & Tooling (HR Tech)
* Systems Implementation: Act as the Project Manager for the selection, integration, and deployment of recruitment technologies (e.g., Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), CRM, AI-sourcing tools, and technical testing platforms).
* Data & Analytics: Build automated dashboards and reporting structures to track key recruitment metrics (e.g., pass-through rates, diversity metrics, and cost-per-hire) to drive data-led decision-making.
* Strategic Scaling & Employer Branding
* Capacity Planning: Collaborate with IT leadership to project future technical headcount needs and build the infrastructure to meet those demands.
* Technical Branding Projects: Lead cross-functional projects with Marketing and Engineering to enhance our "Engineering Brand" (e.g., managing technical blogs, hackathons, or presence at major tech conferences).

**Required Competencies (Hiring Focus)**
**Technical & Analytical Acumen:**

* Systems Thinking: Ability to understand how different HR tools (ATS, LinkedIn, Assessment tools) integrate into a single, seamless ecosystem.
* Data Fluency: Expert ability to use data to identify bottlenecks in the hiring process and propose structural solutions.
* Tech Literacy: A strong understanding of the technical roles you are supporting (e.g., knowing the difference between DevOps, SRE, and Backend Engineering) to better manage the recruitment lifecycle.

**Project Management Mastery**

* Agile Methodology: Ability to run recruitment improvement sprints and manage multiple moving parts (HR Partners, stakeholders, and tech deployments).
* Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence Technology Leaders/managers to adopt new hiring processes or technologies.

**Ideal Candidate Would Be**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  

* Experience: 15+ years in Project Management, specifically within Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, or Tech Recruitment.
* Proven Track Record: Experience leading a major HR Tech implementation or a large-scale recruitment process redesign.
* Education/Certifications: Degree in Business, HR, or IT; PMP or Agile certification is a significant plus.

Leadership Attributes
  
  

* Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline
* Technology curious and future-focused
* Strong influencer and stakeholder manager
* Data-driven and outcome-oriented
* Comfortable operating across global, matrixed environments
* Able to convert ambiguous capability needs into structured programmes
* Passionate about building future-ready technology talent

**BNP Paribas Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
We passionately embrace diversity and foster an inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive. Our policies promote equal opportunity regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability or other factors.

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented
**Sr. Talent Acquisition Executive**
with strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and stakeholder management. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in hiring for both
**White Collar and Blue Collar positions**
, with the ability to close vacancies within defined timelines.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Recruitment:**
  Manage the complete recruitment cycle, from understanding manpower requirements to candidate onboarding.
* **Talent Sourcing:**
  Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, job portals, employee referrals, consultants, and other recruitment channels.
* **Bulk & Blue Collar Hiring:**
  Handle recruitment for production, CNC operators, draughtsmen, interior designers, sales, engineering, and other operational roles.
* **Candidate Screening:**
  Evaluate resumes, conduct initial HR screening, assess candidate suitability, and shortlist profiles as per job requirements.
* **Hiring Manager Coordination:**
  Work closely with department heads to understand job specifications, hiring priorities, and manpower requirements.
* **Interview Management:**
  Schedule interviews, coordinate with candidates and interview panels, collect feedback, and ensure timely follow-ups.
* **Offer Management:**
  Discuss salary expectations, negotiate offers, release offer letters in coordination with HR, and follow up until joining.
* **Recruitment TAT:**
  Track and achieve recruitment targets within defined turnaround times (TAT).
* **MIS & Reporting:**
  Maintain recruitment trackers, vacancy status, sourcing reports, interview feedback, offer status, and joining reports.
* **Joining & Retention:**
  Ensure smooth onboarding, maintain candidate engagement, and minimize offer dropouts and candidate no-shows.
* **Talent Pipeline:**
  Build and maintain a database of qualified candidates for current and future hiring requirements.
* **Recruitment Strategy:**
  Identify effective sourcing channels, improve hiring quality, and optimize recruitment costs.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Vacancy closure within the agreed recruitment TAT.
* Number of qualified candidates sourced and shortlisted.
* Interview-to-selection and offer-to-joining ratios.
* Reduction in offer dropouts and candidate no-shows.
* Quality of hire and hiring manager satisfaction.
* Accuracy and timely submission of recruitment MIS.
* Achievement of monthly hiring targets.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment.
* Strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment and candidate sourcing.
* Experience hiring for both White Collar and Blue Collar positions.
* Proficiency in Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Excel, and recruitment trackers.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and work in a target-driven environment.
* Knowledge of recruitment metrics, notice periods, salary negotiation, and onboarding procedures.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A self-driven recruitment professional with strong sourcing capabilities, excellent follow-up skills, and a proven ability to close multiple vacancies efficiently while maintaining a positive candidate experience.

description:

MS ENTERPRISES OVERSEAS RECRUITMENT SERVICE is a recruitment organization specializing in connecting talent with overseas opportunities across a variety of industries. This is a full-time, on-site Recruiter role based in Mumbai. * Prior experience in recruitment, preferably in overseas or international placement, and a diploma or degree in Human Resources or a related field is preferred.

title: Manager : Corporate Partnerships & Careers
description:
**Who we are**

Plaksha is a 21st-century university focused on solving global challenges through transformative technology education. A unique collective philanthropy effort, our initiative is driven by a dedicated team committed to reimagining technology education in India.

**Role**
– Manager - CPC Outreach

**Location**
: Mumbai

The Manager- CPC Outreach is responsible for driving corporate engagement and building a robust pipeline of industry partners for internship and placement opportunities at Plaksha. Based in Mumbai, this role serves as the primary interface between Plaksha’s Office of Corporate Partnerships & Careers (CPC) and the corporate ecosystem, with a focus on establishing long-term, mutually value-adding relationships with leading organizations. The incumbent works closely with the Head – CPC, internal stakeholders including faculty and students, to align industry engagement with Plaksha’s mission of producing future-ready, industry-relevant talent.

**Job Description**

**Corporate Outreach & Pipeline Development:**

* Identify, approach, and onboard new corporate partners for internships, placements, and broader engagement with Plaksha’s student community.
* Build and manage a structured funnel of leads by mapping target companies, researching hiring needs, and executing a systematic outreach strategy in coordination with the Head – CPC.
* Pitch Plaksha’s talent proposition to senior industry leaders including CHROs, CTOs, COOs, and Business Heads, and independently front-end these high-stakes conversations.

**Relationship Management & Partner Engagement:**

* Develop and deepen relationships with strategic corporate partners with the primary objective of securing firm, repeatable hiring commitments for Plaksha students.
* Act as the key point of contact for partner companies, ensuring timely responses, proactive updates on student profiles, and   seamless coordination during hiring cycles.
* Enhance partner experience by creating year-round touchpoints – company visits, leadership talks, live projects, and co-branded events – beyond just the placement season.
* Maintain a structured CRM of partner interactions, commitments, and engagement history.
* Conceptualize and organize events, industry conclaves, and networking forums that bring together senior leaders and the Plaksha community.
* Leverage events as a platform to deepen existing partnerships and generate new leads for the CPC pipeline.
* Represent Plaksha at external forums, industry associations, and HR conferences to enhance brand visibility in the corporate ecosystem.

**Internship & Placement Execution:**

* Work with the CPC team to plan and execute the annual placement and internship calendar, ensuring adequate corporate   participation across sectors and roles.
* Coordinate with partner companies to gather Job Descriptions, confirm participation timelines, and manage the end-to-end recruitment process on campus.
* Ensure a high quality of roles offered – aligned to Plaksha’s student profiles.
* Oversee the entire placement process, from employer outreach to final offer negotiations, ensuring seamless execution.
* Organize company visits, pre-placement talks, industrial tours, guest lectures, and expert sessions to enhance corporate engagement.
* Work closely with students to provide guidance on career opportunities, resume building, and interview preparation.
* Track offer status, conversion rates, and stipend / CTC data, and maintain accurate placement records for reporting and accreditation purposes.

**Brand Positioning & Market Intelligence:**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of industry hiring trends, competitor university placements, and evolving skill  demands to sharpen Plaksha’s employer positioning.
* Work closely with the founding community, faculty, and students to align industry engagement with academic objectives and student career aspirations.
* Collaborate with faculty to develop co-curricular projects, capstone assignments, and live case studies with corporate partners.
* Leverage professional networks, LinkedIn, and industry databases to generate actionable intelligence on potential partners and role opportunities.
* Provide inputs on Plaksha’s employer branding collateral, student showcase events, and digital outreach to strengthen corporate mindshare.

**Education & Experience**

* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields; MBA with specialization in Sales, Marketing, or Business Development is preferred
* Minimum 12+ years of relevant experience in corporate relations, campus placements, B2B sales, talent advisory, or executive search.
* Prior experience in a university placement office or an organization working at the intersection of academia and industry is an advantage.

**Key Skills**

* Excellent communication skills – oral and written – with the ability to engage senior leaders with confidence and credibility.
* Strong understanding of industry trends, employer expectations, and career pathways for students in technology and innovation
* Strategic thinking ability and analytical skills; ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Commitment to excellence, accuracy, and attention to detail in all external communications and data management.

**What can Plaksha offer you?**

* An opportunity to collaborate and work with the best global academic and business leaders.
* A challenging yet flexible workplace with a focus on excellence and leadership development for all team members.
* A work culture that promotes continuous learning and development, enabling people to be their best selves.
* An opportunity to be part of one of the largest collective philanthropy initiatives to reimagine higher education and build future skills for the next generation.

Please apply here or email your application on shreya.bhatia@plaksha.edu.in

description:
**Sr. HR Executive | Nuvo Aeon Diamond & Jewellery**

📍 Mumbai (On-site) · 🕘 Full-time · 3 to 6 years of experience · Reports to the Founder

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Sr. HR Executive to own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to joining formalities and payroll. You’ll create a smooth experience for candidates and employees while keeping our HR processes accurate, compliant, and on time.

**What You’ll Do**

**Recruitment**

* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower needs and draft job descriptions
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and consultants
* Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate interview schedules
* Manage the hiring pipeline, track metrics (time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, offer-to-join ratio), and maintain the ATS or tracker

**Onboarding and Joining Formalities**

* Issue offer and appointment letters and collect signed acceptances
* Collect and verify joining documents (ID proofs, education and experience certificates, relieving letters, and more)
* Coordinate background verification with third-party vendors

* Run induction sessions and check in with new hires at 30, 60, and 90 days
* Manage probation tracking and confirmations

**Payroll Administration**

* Collect and validate monthly inputs: attendance, leaves, overtime, joiners, exits, and salary changes
* Process monthly payroll accurately and within deadlines, and resolve payslip queries
* Ensure statutory compliance for PF, ESI, and Professional Tax
* Support full and final settlements for exiting employees
* Maintain payroll records

**General HR Operations**

* Maintain employee master data, personnel files, and HR MIS reports
* Handle exit formalities, including resignation acceptance, clearance, and exit interviews
* Support HR policy implementation and employee engagement activities
* Respond to employee queries on policies, benefits, and payroll

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred)
* 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience across recruitment, onboarding, and payroll
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT)
* Experience with HRMS or payroll software (such as HRone, greytHR, or Keka) and advanced Excel
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy with numbers
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
* Confidentiality and sound judgement with sensitive data
* Negotiation and stakeholder management skills
* A problem-solving, service-oriented mindset

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Time-to-fill and offer-to-join ratio
* Onboarding completed within the defined timeline
* Error-free payroll and on-time salary disbursement
* New hire satisfaction and 90-day retention

**How to Apply:**
Send your CV to hr@nadiamonds.com, or apply directly on LinkedIn.

title: FOUNDER’S OFFICE – PEOPLE & CULTURE
description: First a little about us: TrueDiamond is India’s largest designer RINGS atelier - and possibly the most fun troublemaker the jewellery world has seen in a while. We’re disrupting the way fine jewellery is marketed in the country: no brides, no cheesy romance ads. Instead, we tell witty, wildly relatable & fun stories and create rings that feel like identity, energy, and personality - not “occasion wear.” Our content is bold & risky, and our rings steal the spotlight. If you’re someone who wants to help shape culture, taste and aesthetic - not just “work at a company” - you’ll feel at home hereWe need exceptional people, a kick-ass culture, and an organisation that can scale without losing its soul.That's where you come in.The role: Chief Human Enabler. Culture Ninja. People Person.Okay, your official title is Founder’s Office – People & Culture. You would effectively lead HR but think of this as much more than a conventional HR role.You’ll work closely with the founders to build the organisation from the inside out - finding brilliant people, making them better, creating a culture they’re proud of, and building the systems that let everyone do their best work.You’ll have a front-row seat to building a fast-growing consumer brand, direct access to the founders, and the freedom to make things happen rather than wait for five levels of approval.What will you actually do?1. Find our people.Build a team of exceptional people across marketing, retail, operations and everything in between.Own the hiring journey, from writing compelling JDs and sourcing talent to interviews, offers and onboarding.Find people who bring not just the right skills, but the right attitude, ambition and cultural fit.Make candidates fall in love with the opportunity - even before they join us.2. Build a culture people give a damn about.Help define what True Diamond stands for as an employer.Create an environment built on ownership, speed, trust, transparency and high standards.Make performance, feedback, recognition and employee engagement part of how we work - not just things we talk about.Build rituals, experiences and initiatives that make work meaningful, without turning the office into a forced-fun factory.3. Make the people engine run like clockwork.Own core HR operations: payroll coordination, policies, attendance, leave, employee records, compliance and documentation.Build simple, scalable processes that make life easier for employees and managers.Ensure the basics are done brilliantly, consistently and on time.Bring structure to the chaos without killing the creativity.4. Be the founders’ go-to person for all things people.Work directly with the founders on organisation design, team structure, hiring priorities and people strategy.Help managers become better leaders and teams become more effective.Tackle difficult conversations and people problems with empathy, fairness and a healthy dose of common sense.Spot organisational issues before they become organisational disasters.5. Make us better as we grow.Build performance management and development frameworks that help people grow with the business.Use data and feedback to understand what’s working and what needs fixing.Keep asking: How do we build a better place to work without becoming another boring company?Who are we looking for?We care less about fancy designations or experience and more about the fire in your belly & what you can do.You could be an recruitment professional who wants a bigger mandate, a People & Culture enthusiast who loves building things from scratch, or a high-ownership operator who has discovered that their superpower is making teams work better.You should ideally bring:1-3 years of experience in HR, People & Culture, talent acquisition or a related role. We’re open to exceptional candidates outside this range. (Freshers too)Strong hiring instincts and the ability to identify genuinely great talent.A basic understanding of HR operations, including payroll, policies and employee lifecycle management.Excellent communication skills and the confidence to handle difficult conversations.A bias for action. You see a problem, take ownership and find a solution.The maturity to balance empathy with accountability and fun with high standards.Comfort with ambiguity, fast-paced environments and building processes where none exist yet.Most importantly, you should enjoy working with people, have strong opinions but low ego, and care about building something that matters.What’s in it for you?A seat at the table: Work directly with the founders and influence how the company grows.A genuinely broad role: Shape hiring, culture, organisation design and business execution - not just one HR vertical.A blank canvas: Build systems and initiatives from scratch instead of inheriting a 200-page employee handbook from 1998.Real ownership: We want someone who makes decisions, takes initiative and gets things done.Room to grow: As the business scales, so can your role, responsibilities and impact.A team with personality: We take our ambitions seriously. Ourselves? Not always. A small disclaimer.We currently work a six-day week. We know, the internet might have some thoughts. Could that change someday? Maybe. But for now, that's how we roll.If building something ambitious with a bunch of crazy, passionate people excites you, we hope it's worth the extra day! This isn't a 9-to-5 role where you tick boxes, send birthday emails and call it culture.Some days, you'll be interviewing brilliant candidates. Other days, you'll be fixing a payroll issue, navigating a difficult conversation or figuring out why a process that worked for 20 people doesn't work for 100.You'll need to be strategic enough to think big and hands-on enough to get the basics right.If that sounds exciting rather than exhausting, we might just get along.Interested?Click 'Apply Now' below to fill the form or send us your CV along with a short note telling us.Why you think you are an ideal fit for this role.What part of the role excites you & what part scares you.We don't need a five-page cover letter. We like people who get to the point.Come build the team behind True Diamond.

title: Talent Acquisition Administrator

* Collaborate with internal departments (IT, hiring managers, Administration) to facilitate seamless employee experience.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience by ensuring effective communication and timely follow-up throughout the recruitment process.

Who You Are:

* One to two years of experience in a Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or Administrative Human Resources field.
* Proficient knowledge of HR Information Systems (HRIS) or employee management systems.
* Competent Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
* Holds a bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

As we continue to grow our team across Mumbai and Delhi, we’re looking for a proactive and people-oriented HR professional who can help us build a strong team, streamline our HR processes, and create a positive working environment.

* Screen resumes, shortlist candidates, schedule interviews, and coordinate with the hiring team.

**2. Employee Management & Engagement**

* Be the primary point of contact for employees regarding HR-related matters.

* Manage employee onboarding, documentation, attendance, leave records, and exit formalities.

* Build a positive, professional, and supportive work culture.

**3. Salary, Incentives & Performance Management**

* Maintain employee salary structures, incentive plans, and relevant HR records.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and ensure salary processing happens on time.
* Track performance reviews, employee goals, appraisals, and growth opportunities.
* Help develop clear role structures, reporting systems, and incentive policies.
* Coordinate with management on salary revisions, promotions, and performance-related decisions.

**4. Employee Growth & Development**

* Understand employees’ responsibilities, strengths, and development needs.
* Help define clear roles, responsibilities, and career progression paths.
* Track employee performance and follow up on individual growth plans.
* Support managers in building a more accountable, motivated, and efficient team.

**5. HR Operations & Process Building**

* Maintain employee databases, HR documents, policies, and internal records.
* Create simple and effective HR systems suited to a growing company.
* Help establish structured processes for hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, and employee management.
* Coordinate HR operations for our hybrid team across different cities.

Who Are We Looking For?

* Someone with 1–3 years of experience in HR, recruitment, or people operations.
* A good communicator who is comfortable speaking with candidates, employees, and management.
* Someone organised, responsible, approachable, and proactive.
* A person who understands the basics of recruitment, employee management, and salary administration.
* Someone comfortable using LinkedIn for recruitment and familiar with spreadsheets and basic HR tools.
* A professional who wants to learn, grow, and take ownership rather than simply follow instructions.
* Someone who can work independently in a growing company where HR processes are still evolving.

**Fresh perspectives are welcome.**
We value practical skills, a willingness to learn, and the ability to get things done over experience in a large corporate setup.

Why Join Celebistaan?

* Opportunity to build and shape the HR function from an early stage.
* Direct interaction with the management team and involvement in business decisions related to people.
* A chance to contribute to employee growth, team building, and company culture.
* Exposure to the fast-moving influencer marketing and creator economy.
* Room to learn, take responsibility, and grow with the company.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role will be based in
**Mumbai**
, with a hybrid work arrangement. Our team operates across Mumbai and Delhi, so the candidate should be comfortable coordinating with employees and candidates across locations.

We are gradually building Mumbai as our central headquarters, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us through this phase.

If you enjoy working with people, building teams, solving problems, and creating simple systems that help a company grow, we’d love to hear from you.

Please share your resume and a brief introduction about your HR experience.

📩

.

title: Head of Talent and Corporate Relations, India, supporting the University of Leeds
company: Acumen, Part of Sannam S4 Group
description:
**What are we seeking?**

Are you an exceptional business developer with a strong understanding of the Indian labour market and employer landscape? We are seeking a driven professional to shape partnerships that enhance career outcomes for students and graduates at one of the UK’s largest Russell Group universities, ranked in the global top 100 (QS World University Rankings 2027), a client of Acumen.

Supporting the Student Opportunity service within the Directorate of Student Success & Educational Engagement, working closely with the client’s International Office and Acumen India in-Country representatives, you will help build strategic partnerships in India that enhance student and graduate employability.

Supporting Acumen in‑country representation mandate, you will act as a dedicated resource for employability and business development activities in India, helping build strategic partnerships with employers, industry bodies, higher and professional education partners, and India’s start‑up ecosystem. Alumni will be central to this work, acting as ambassadors, connectors, mentors, employers, and advocates. Operating at the intersection of higher education and labour markets, you will help convert employer insight and market intelligence into high‑impact opportunities. You will help champion a distinctive talent proposition, helping position the client’s graduates as globally experienced professionals.

A key priority of the role will be to explore and assess the potential phased development of client’s India Talent Hub, a flagship employability and talent partnership initiative in India. Bringing together employers, start‑ups, alumni, investors, industry, and the client, the postholder will investigate how the Hub could create exclusive internships, experiential learning, and graduate career and entrepreneurship opportunities through the client’s India Graduate Careers Advancement Programme.

We are looking for an experienced business development professional with a strong understanding of the Indian market. You will be commercially astute, highly collaborative, and confident operating independently and across organisational boundaries. With a proven ability to identify opportunities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment, you will bring energy, insight, and strategic focus to this role. You will be based in India, or willing and able to relocate, with the appropriate right to work. The role requires regular travel across India and internationally, along with occasional evening and weekend working.

**Responsibilities**

**India Talent Hub**

* Support the phased development of the client's India Talent Hub, as part of service delivery, aligned to demand, partnerships and institutional priorities - strengthening employer engagement, alumni connectivity, graduate employability and the client’s profile in India.

**Client profile building and stakeholder engagement**

* Support the client’s profile-building in India through strategic employability related activities, events and partnerships, acting in a liaison and coordination capacity as part of Acumen's in-country representation services.
* Engage with agents and prospective students to share information regarding the client’s employability support value proposition in India and outcomes.

**Business Development**

* Support the building of strategic employer partnerships across priority sectors in India, including Multinational Corporations (MNCs)
  **,**
  Global Capability Centres (GCCs),
  Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs),
  and the Indian start-up ecosystem, facilitating introductions and liaison to assist the client in positioning itself as a trusted international talent partner.
* Identify and communicate opportunities arising from the UK–India Vision 2035, Viksit Bharat @2047, and the UK–India Free Trade Agreement to drive collaboration in innovation, employment, and priority industries, supporting the client’s profile and partnerships through Acumen's in-country representation activities.
* Support the development of long-term hiring pipelines for internships and graduate roles, facilitating employer participation in employability, enterprise, and experiential learning initiatives in a liaison and coordination capacity.
* Support a city-based engagement strategy across India’s major metro centres (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR) and other key growth cities (e.g. Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad), taking a prioritised approach to where and how activity is developed, aligned with client’s strategy.
* Engage with employer forums, industry body events, and networks, supporting the client's profile-building activities in a liaison capacity.
* Facilitate awareness of the value of globally trained graduates and alumni of the client, supporting the creation of structured recruitment pathways and positioning alumni as contributors to national and bilateral priorities, in a liaison and introductory capacity.
* Coordinate employer relationships and liaise across the client university to enable facilitate cross-referrals and support strategic partnership opportunities.

**Alumni Engagement**

* Liaise with the client’s advancement team to support alumni engagement; assisting in building and supporting active alumni volunteer and supporter networks; connecting former Spark students with current students to explore business creation; and facilitating alumni connections as career mentors, advocates and employer connectors.

**Employability**

* Facilitate the communication of employability needs and aspirations of the client’s educated Indian graduates to India-based employers, including start-ups, in a liaison and introductory capacity.
* Support delivery of the India Graduate Careers Advancement Programme through employer, alumni, and graduate engagement, in a coordination and liaison capacity.
* Liaise with the Careers Service and Alumni Engagement team to facilitate India-focused employer events, career mentoring opportunities, internships, and experiential learning, with clear referral routes to specialist University-based careers support.

**Market Intelligence**

* Gather and provide in-country insight on India’s graduate recruitment market, including skills demand, employer needs, priority sectors, and policy developments.
* Help translate market intelligence into strategic insight, including production of an annual India Talent Report to inform the client's personnel in their employability strategy and decision-making.

These duties provide a framework for the role and should not be regarded as a definitive list. Other reasonable duties may be required consistent with the grade of the post.

**What Will You Bring to the Role?**

**Essential**

* Based in India, or willing and able to relocate, with appropriate right to work, and willingness to travel regularly within India and internationally as required.
* Fluent Hindi and strong professional English.
* Proven experience in business development, employer engagement, talent acquisition or a related field, with a strong track record in building corporate relationships and identifying mutual value.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including HR leaders, with strong commercial awareness and the confidence to communicate the client’s approved priorities and value proposition externally.
* Strong understanding of the Indian labour market, employer landscape and graduate recruitment practices.
* Excellent relationship building skills, with the ability to develop and sustain partnerships across employers, industry and strategic stakeholders.
* Highly organised, with strong planning and time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, matrix environment.
* Collaborative and adaptable, with experience of working across teams and functions to deliver shared objectives and contribute to cross organisational initiatives.

**Desirable**

* Established employer, HR or industry networks in India.
* Experience of working with higher education institutions, alumni, or across entrepreneurship, start-up or innovation ecosystems.
* Experience of campus-based graduate recruitment within India.
* Experience of working across multiple regions in India or understanding of regional economic and labour market dynamics.

• Communicate process changes, new initiatives and additional service offerings to stakeholders as they are introduced.

**Delivery and Operations**

• Deliver the agreed annual hiring plan, tracked as a monthly fulfilment percentage against plan.

• Hold time-to-fill within the contracted SLA for each role band and review every ageing requisition in the weekly account review.

• Review team, recruiting numbers and SLA performance on a set cadence, and act on any measure falling below

benchmark.

• Maintain offer-to-join conversion at 85% or above through structured candidate engagement from offer release to date

of joining.

• Ensure governance and compliance across policy, process and procedure, with zero audit exceptions on the account.

**Sourcing and Talent Pipeline**

• Lead hands-on sourcing for critical and niche mandates; head-hunt for roles that portals cannot fill.

• Gain a working understanding of the assigned business — structure, nature of work and challenges faced — so that

sourcing strategy is built against anticipated demand rather than live vacancies alone.

• Build and maintain ready pipelines of active and passive candidates for repeat-demand and hard-to-fill roles.

• Engage specialised, high-skilled and difficult-to-attract talent through professional networks, portals and direct

approach.

**Market Intelligence and Reporting**

• Analyse recruitment trends, results and insights — business unit, client and external market — and share them with

the client and Taggd peers to shape future hiring activity.

• Share market intelligence — talent availability, compensation trends, competitor movement — in every monthly

review.

**People Management**

• Create KPIs for every team member on the HRMS and manage performance against them through the year.

• Plan and track training so the team is set up to deliver against its targets.

• Run structured engagement connects and build a documented career path for each team member

**Candidate Profile-**

This role suits someone who has already run a recruitment team against a hiring plan, not someone stepping into team

management for the first time. The successful candidate will:

• Bring 8+ years in search or RPO delivery, including experience leading a team of 10+ recruiters. Candidates who have

not managed at this scale will not be considered.

• Have hired at volume in manufacturing, automobile, auto component, heavy machinery, OEM or electric vehicle

businesses, and know where the talent sits and what it costs. This sector exposure is a requirement of the role, not a

preference.

• Still source personally on the mandates that matter, through head-hunting, Boolean and advanced search, portals and

professional networks.

• Hold their own with business heads and senior HR stakeholders, and hold a consultative hiring conversation rather

than take an order.

• Communicate with authority in writing and in the room.

• Work to a target and carry a delivery orientation into the team.

• Be fluent with ATS and database management, and advanced in MS Office.

• Be a graduate in any discipline; a postgraduate qualification or an MBA or PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.

• Source with AI-driven search and AI-enabled tools — CV matching, Gen AI Boolean strings and adverts, automated

outreach — and measure what each one actually yields.

• Run the weekly delivery dashboard and the monthly account MIS, and act on what the numbers show rather than only

reporting them.

• Build recruiter capability — find the skill gaps across the team, coach against them, and add capability where the plan

needs it.

* Build and maintain talent pipelines for process, mechanical, rotating equipment, electrical, instrumentation and control, integrity, marine engineering, project management, and planning disciplines.
* Partner with hiring managers to define job descriptions, selection criteria, and realistic hiring expectations.
* Assess candidates for technical suitability, relevant certifications, notice periods, and salary expectations before shortlisting.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate records, interview feedback, and follow-up actions.
* Ensure timely candidate communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Coordinate FPSO onshore engineering recruitment and client CV submissions when required.
* Monitor recruitment progress, report on open positions and hiring risks, and proactively address searches that may exceed 45 days.
* Support improvements to recruitment tools, processes, and the talent database.

**What we are looking for**

* 6–9 years of overall recruitment experience, including at least 5 years of recruiting engineering, technical, or project professionals.
* Minimum 2 years of recruitment experience in oil & gas, EPC, marine, or heavy engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Boolean search, headhunting, and referral-based sourcing.
* Ability to independently assess engineering CVs, technical disciplines, seniority, and role suitability.
* Confidence in engaging with engineers, operations managers, and hiring stakeholders to understand technical requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management, candidate engagement, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Good organisational skills with a strong focus on recruitment data accuracy, follow-ups, and multiple concurrent searches.
* Ability to manage offer negotiations, notice periods, and counteroffers within approved budgets.

**Preferred qualifications and experience:**

* Experience with a specialist oil & gas recruitment agency or in-house recruitment team.
* Exposure to client CV submission and approval processes and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* A graduate qualification; an engineering degree or diploma will be an advantage.
* Recruitment or HR-related qualifications will be an added advantage.

**What you can expect**

* An opportunity to work with a global organisation in the oil & gas industry.
* Exposure to diverse technical, engineering, project, and corporate hiring requirements.
* Collaboration with experienced stakeholders across onshore and offshore operations.
* A professional environment that values trust, accountability, care, and innovation.
* Opportunities to contribute to recruitment strategy, talent pipeline development, and process improvement.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about talent acquisition and have a strong track record of recruiting technical and engineering professionals, we would love to hear from you. Join OCS Services and be part of a team supporting critical energy operations through the right talent.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Human Resource Executive**

**Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai (On-site)**

**Full-time | Mon–Fri 9:30 AM–6:30 PM, Saturday WFH**

**YOE: 3–4 Years**

**About Gajab**

India bargains. E-commerce forgot.

Gajab is India's first AI-powered bargaining marketplace recreating the bazaar experience online for Tier 2/3 India. We're a fast-growing team of 30+ and building the people systems that will scale with us.

**The Role**

We're looking for an HR Executive who is equal parts organized and people-first. You'll work directly with the Sr. HR Manager and own the operational backbone of HR at Gajab recruitment coordination, candidate communication, onboarding, employee engagement, office administration, and everything in between.

This is a hands-on role in a lean HR team. Real ownership, real visibility, and a steep learning curve. If you want to understand how HR works end-to-end at a fast-moving startup from chasing candidates on WhatsApp to planning Friday game sessions this is it.

**What You'll Do**

**Candidate Communication & Recruitment Ops**

* Own daily multi-channel candidate communication calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails for all open profiles
* Maintain and update a structured candidate tracker sheet across all stages applied, screened, interviewed, offered, and joined
* Track all rolled-out offers follow up with candidates on acceptance, joining confirmation, and document submission
* Coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers and send timely reminders to candidates
* Source candidates actively via Naukri, LinkedIn, Internshala, and other relevant platform

**On boarding & Off boarding**

* Own smooth onboarding for all new hires documentation, system access, induction scheduling, and buddy assignment
* Share offer letters, appointment letters, and employment agreements
* Track probation periods and ensure confirmation letters are issued on time
* Manage exit formalities clearance checklists, relieving letters, full and final settlements, and exit interviews

**Daily HR Operations & Admin Support**

* Share daily and weekly attendance and leave updates with the Sr.People Manager
* Track employee attendance, leaves, and flag discrepancies or patterns early
* Resolve employee queries on leaves, small policy changes, and routine HR processes same day where possible
* Stay actively in touch with remote team members for check-ins, updates, and coordination
* Support the Sr. People Manager on day-to-day tasks, follow-ups, and ad hoc HR requirements

**Office & Facility Audits**

* Conduct regular housekeeping audits to ensure office cleanliness and hygiene standards are maintained
* Carry out bio metric and CCTV camera audits flag issues and coordinate with the admin team for resolution
* Maintain an audit log and share weekly status with the Sr. People Manager

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Track and prepare birthday and work anniversary shoutouts coordinate gifts, cards, or celebrations as applicable
* Support and execute Friday game sessions and team engagement activities end-to-end
* Coordinate employee engagement events, team outings, and cultural initiatives
* Support implementation of recognition and rewards programs
* Be the friendly first point of contact for employees for day-to-day HR queries

**Compliance & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and documentation
* Support monthly payroll inputs attendance, leave records, additions, and deductions
* Support audit readiness by maintaining organized and accessible HR documentation

**Performance Management L&D Support**

* Coordinate the performance review cycle schedule reviews, collect feedback, and maintain tracker
* Track probation and appraisal timelines and send timely reminders to managers
* Support training and development initiatives logistics, scheduling, and attendance tracking

**HR Reporting & MIS**

* Maintain weekly HR MIS headcount, open positions, offer tracker, and hiring pipeline
* Prepare HR dashboards and reports for the Sr. HR Manager's review

**What Success Looks Like in 60 Days**

* Candidate tracker live, updated daily, and shared with Sr. People Manager without reminders
* Zero pending offer follow-ups every rolled-out offer tracked to a clear outcome
* Attendance and leave updates shared with Sr. HR Manager every morning, consistently
* Housekeeping and biometric audits conducted on schedule with a clean log maintained
* Friday engagement sessions planned and executed with team participation
* All onboarding and offboarding documentation completed without delays

**Must Have's**

* 2–3 years of HR experience, preferably in a startup or e-commerce environment
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Comfortable managing high-volume candidate communication daily across calls, WhatsApp, and email
* Strong organizational skills able to maintain multiple trackers and meet daily deadlines
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills warm, clear, and professional
* Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets comfortable building and maintaining trackers
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

**Nice to Have's**

* Prior experience using HRMS tools such as Keka
* Experience coordinating employee engagement or office administration tasks
* Familiarity with Naukri Recruiter, LinkedIn Recruiter, or Internshala for active sourcing

**This Role Isn't For You If**

* You prefer a siloed role with a narrow, fixed task list
* You're not comfortable switching between recruitment, admin, and engagement tasks in the same day
* You need heavy supervision before taking initiative on routine HR tasks
* You find people-heavy, high-communication work draining rather than energizing

**Why Join Gajab**

* End-to-end HR ownership in a fast-growing startup not just one slice of the function
* Work directly with a Sr. HRBP and get exposure to strategic HR, not just operations
* Be part of building Gajab's people function and culture from the ground up
* Fast learning curve, real impact, and a team that genuinely values the HR function

**Interview Process**

* Round 1: HR Screening (20–30 min) This can be virtual call.
* Round 2: HR Ops Test – Tech round and Operational Questions
* Round 3: Sr. HR Manager Round (30–45 min) This is face to face round.

*Expected turnaround: 1 week.*

**Job description:**

**Title: Senior HR Manager**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Experience: 6–8 Years**

**Industry Preference: D2C | Wellness | Beauty | Lifestyle | Nutrition | FMCG | Consumer Brands**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Role Overview:**

As the Senior HR Manager, you will be responsible for driving the complete HR function across the employee lifecycle — from workforce planning and hiring to performance management, employee engagement, culture, policies, compliance, and retention.

You will work closely with the founders and business leadership to build a scalable, high-performance organisation and ensure that HR evolves in line with the company’s growth.

The ideal candidate will be a strong people leader, business partner, problem solver, and culture builder who can operate independently and bring structure to a rapidly growing organisation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. HR Strategy & Business Partnering

\* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy aligned with Ace Blend’s business objectives and growth plans.

\* Partner closely with founders, leadership and functional heads on people-related decisions.

\* Translate business requirements into effective people strategies and processes.

\* Drive workforce planning, organisation design and manpower budgeting.

\* Identify organisational gaps and recommend solutions around people, structure and capability.

\* Build HR systems and processes that can scale with the organisation.

\* Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on employee, performance and organisational matters.

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

\* Own the end-to-end recruitment strategy across functions and levels.

\* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and define role expectations.

\* Build strong talent pipelines across business-critical functions.

\* Develop effective sourcing strategies through LinkedIn, referrals, agencies, networks and other channels.

\* Manage senior and niche hiring mandates independently.

\* Drive employer branding initiatives to strengthen Ace Blend’s talent proposition.

\* Track recruitment metrics including time-to-hire, quality of hire, offer-to-joining ratio and hiring costs.

\* Build a strong candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.

3. Performance Management

\* Own and strengthen the company’s performance management framework.

\* Drive goal-setting, KRAs/KPIs and performance review cycles.

\* Partner with managers to ensure effective performance conversations and feedback mechanisms.

\* Identify high performers, underperformers and critical talent.

\* Develop performance improvement plans wherever required.

\* Build a culture of accountability, ownership and continuous feedback.

\* Work with leadership on succession planning and talent development.

4. Employee Engagement & Culture

\* Build and strengthen Ace Blend’s culture as the organisation scales.

\* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives, events and internal communication.

\* Develop initiatives focused on employee experience, recognition and retention.

\* Conduct employee pulse checks and engagement surveys.

\* Identify employee concerns and proactively address them.

\* Create a positive, inclusive and high-performance work environment.

\* Strengthen internal communication between leadership and employees.

5. Learning & Development

\* Identify organisation-wide and function-specific learning requirements.

\* Build annual learning and development plans.

\* Work with external trainers, consultants and platforms wherever required.

\* Develop leadership and managerial capability within the organisation.

\* Create career development frameworks and growth paths for employees.

\* Promote continuous learning and upskilling.

6. HR Policies, Processes & Compliance

\* Build, review and implement HR policies and processes across the employee lifecycle.

\* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.

\* Own processes related to onboarding, probation, confirmation, transfers, promotions and exits.

\* Ensure effective implementation of POSH and other statutory policies.

\* Partner with external consultants/legal advisors wherever required.

\* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records.

\* Continuously identify opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience.

7. HR Operations & HRMS

\* Oversee day-to-day HR operations and ensure smooth employee lifecycle management.

\* Manage and optimise HRMS, attendance, leave and payroll processes.

\* Work closely with finance/payroll teams to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing.

\* Ensure employee documentation and records are maintained accurately.

\* Build HR dashboards and reports for leadership.

\* Track key people metrics and provide actionable insights to management.

8. Employee Relations

\* Act as the primary point of escalation for employee-related matters.

\* Handle grievances, conflicts and disciplinary matters professionally.

\* Support managers in handling sensitive employee situations.

\* Ensure fair and consistent application of company policies.

\* Conduct exit interviews and identify trends impacting attrition and retention.

\* Develop initiatives to improve employee retention and overall experience.

9. Organisation Development

\* Support the organisation through periods of rapid growth and change.

\* Build scalable organisational structures, processes and people practices.

\* Identify capability gaps and recommend hiring/development interventions.

\* Support leadership in building high-performing teams.

\* Develop frameworks for career progression, succession planning and internal mobility.

\* Help create a strong leadership pipeline as the organisation expands.

10. HR Analytics & Reporting

\* Develop and maintain HR dashboards and monthly people reports.

\* Track metrics such as:

\* Headcount

\* Attrition

\* Hiring

\* Cost per hire

\* Time to hire

\* Employee engagement

\* Absenteeism

\* Performance

\* Retention

\* Present people insights and recommendations to leadership.

\* Use data to identify trends and support better people decisions.

**What We Are Looking For:**

\* 6–8 years of overall HR experience, with significant experience in a generalist/HRBP/people leadership capacity.

\* Prior experience in D2C, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, nutrition, FMCG, retail, consumer brands or startup environments is highly preferred.

\* Strong understanding of the complete employee lifecycle.

\* Proven experience in building HR processes in a growing organisation.

\* Strong experience in talent acquisition and stakeholder management.

\* Hands-on experience with performance management and employee engagement.

\* Good understanding of HR compliance and labour laws.

\* Strong communication, interpersonal and influencing skills.

\* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with maturity.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic and ambiguous environment.

\* High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently.

\* Strong business understanding and commercial orientation.

**Preferred Background:**

We would particularly value candidates who have worked with:

D2C Brands | Wellness | Nutrition | Beauty | Skincare | Personal Care | Lifestyle | FMCG | Retail | Consumer Tech | Premium Consumer Brands | High-Growth Startups

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
All positionsSenior Talent Acquisition Manager PeopleMumbai, IndiaFull-time Apply Now

**About the Role**

As Senior Talent Acquisition Manager at IQWorks, you will own hiring across the company. You will partner with the founders and function leads to shape roles, build sourcing pipelines from scratch, run structured interview processes, and close candidates in a competitive market for engineering, AI, privacy, and go-to-market talent. This is a hands-on, full-cycle role — you will source and screen as much as you will design the hiring bar, the employer brand, and the candidate experience that make strong people want to join us. You will also lay the foundations of the wider people function as we grow: hiring plans, interview scorecards, compensation benchmarking, and onboarding. Because we build data protection software, you will handle candidate data with the same care we expect of our customers. We support hybrid working and flexible hours, and we look for people who bring the consistency and responsiveness that high-ownership work depends on. This role is based in Mumbai.

**What You Will Do**

* Own full-cycle recruitment across engineering, AI, privacy, sales, and marketing — from role intake through offer, close, and joining
* Build and run direct sourcing pipelines through outreach, referrals, and communities, rather than depending on agencies
* Partner with the founders and function leads to define role scorecards, hiring plans, and interview loops that actually predict performance
* Run structured interview processes and coach interviewers so decisions stay evidence-based and the bar stays high
* Own the candidate experience end to end — clear communication, fast turnarounds, and a process candidates recommend to others
* Benchmark compensation, construct offers, and lead negotiations through to signed acceptance and a confirmed start date
* Build the employer brand alongside marketing — careers content, social presence, and how IQWorks shows up to the talent market
* Track and report hiring metrics — pipeline health, time to hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance — and use them to fix bottlenecks
* Lay the foundations of the wider people function as we scale, including onboarding, hiring policy, and people operations

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years in talent acquisition, including at least 2 years hiring for technology roles
* Proven full-cycle ownership — you have sourced, screened, closed, and onboarded, not only coordinated a process someone else designed
* Strong technical sourcing ability — you can read an engineering or AI role spec and find, engage, and assess the right people yourself
* Track record of hiring in competitive markets and closing candidates who hold multiple offers
* Experience designing structured interview processes, scorecards, and hiring bars, and getting busy teams to follow them
* Excellent written and spoken communication — you represent the company to every candidate you touch
* Sound judgment on handling candidate data responsibly, with confidentiality treated as non-negotiable
* Effective use of AI as a force multiplier across the hiring workflow — sourcing, outreach, screening, scheduling, and reporting — with sharp judgment about where human oversight is essential so candidate experience and hiring quality are never compromised
* Comfort operating as a team of one and building the function from first principles
* Based in Mumbai, and a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

**Nice to Have**

* Experience hiring for data privacy, security, compliance, or governance products
* Prior experience as an early talent or people hire at a high-growth startup
* Exposure to hiring in the Middle East or other international markets
* Experience hiring senior and leadership roles
* Familiarity with modern applicant tracking and sourcing tooling
* Background in people operations, onboarding, or compensation design beyond recruitment
* Experience running employer brand or hiring-content programs alongside marketing

title: Assistant Talent Acquisition Manager (Retail)
description:
**Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition (Retail)**

**Location – Lower Parel, Mumbai**

**About Company:**

The Souled Store is a homegrown youth casual-wear brand founded in 2013. Today, we are one of India’s largest online merchandising platforms, with licensing partnerships including Disney, Warner Bros., WWE, IPL and Viacom18, among others.

We create products inspired by pop culture- superheroes, movies, TV shows and cartoons while staying deeply rooted in evolving youth fashion and lifestyle trends. Alongside our core men’s and women’s apparel categories, we are actively expanding into new product lines such as activewear, Supima products, personal care, footwear and backpacks.

While we began as a digital-first brand, we have steadily expanded into offline retail and currently operate 90+ stores across India, with further pan-India expansion underway.

The Souled Store was built on a simple belief: people do their best work when they love what they do. We believe work should be driven by ownership, curiosity and leadership at every level not just by titles. Over the years, we’ve built a team of like-minded individuals who work smart, take accountability and grow with the business.

If you resonate with our culture and want to be part of an aggressively scaling, consumer-first brand, we’d love to have you join us!

**Role Summary:**

Owns hiring for Store Managers, Area Managers and all corporate office roles within Retail Ops. Reports to Senior Manager – HR.

**Key responsibilities**

**1.Hiring delivery:**
Run full-cycle hiring across three mandates:

* Store Managers, including leadership for new store launches.
* Area Managers.
* Retail Ops corporate roles, such as retail MIS/analytics, training, audit and compliance, retail excellence, and ops leadership.

**2.Sourcing:**
Map talent at fashion and lifestyle retailers for field roles, source cross-industry for corporate roles (analytics, training, audit), headhunt through LinkedIn and referrals, and manage a small panel of search partners.

**3.Internal pipeline:**
Work with Retail HRBPs to identify promotion-ready ASMs for Store Manager roles and strong Store Managers for Area Manager roles and run internal job postings before going external.

**4.Assessment:**
Build role-specific selection:

* For field roles: store walk-throughs and P&L or KPI deep-dives.
* For corporate roles: functional assignments or case discussions.

**5.Offer management:**
Benchmark compensation, negotiate within approved bands and the approval matrix, and manage candidates through to joining.

**6.Stakeholder management:**
Partner with Retail Ops leadership and Area Managers on manpower plans and interview panels and run fortnightly hiring reviews.

**7.Reporting:**
Track TAT, offer-to-join ratio, source mix, cost per hire and 6-month retention by role category.

**Requirement**
:

* 5–8 years in talent acquisition, with at least 5+ years in retail or consumer hiring.
* Experience hiring both field leadership and corporate functional roles.
* Strong retail network; skilled in headhunting, assessment and negotiation; comfortable with multi-city travel.

 Head – Operations
 



  





**About Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF)** 




 Maker Bhavan Foundation (MBF) is a non\-profit organization transforming engineering education across India by shifting learning from theoretical instruction to hands\-on, active problem\-solving. Founded by visionary tech alumni, entrepreneurs, and academicians, MBF equips academic institutions with the tools, funding, and expertise needed to cultivate future\-ready innovators and engineers. Through its flagship Tinkerers' Labs (24/7 student\-led makerspaces), MBF gives students direct access to rapid prototyping technology. Its high\-impact initiatives, such as the InventX summer invention internship, the Vishwakarma Awards, and the Center for Essential Skills, foster both technical ingenuity and professional readiness. Collaborating directly with governing bodies like AICTE on Project PRACTICE, MBF works to integrate project\-based learning into Tier\-II and Tier\-III colleges. Driven by a vision to embed a vibrant maker culture into higher education, Maker Bhavan Foundation aims to expand to 100s of engineering colleges by 2030, directly empowering 10% of India's graduating engineers each year to translate bold ideas into real\-world technological solutions.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview** 




 STEM Shiksha Foundation is seeking a highly organized and proactive
 **HR \& Admin Manager** 
 to manage our day\-to\-day office operations and internal people processes.
 



 This is an execution\-heavy role for someone who enjoys building order out of chaos. You will be the backbone of the office—ensuring our physical and digital workspaces run like clockwork while managing the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our growing team. We need a "doer" who is comfortable switching between vendor negotiations and recruitment screenings with ease.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Office Administration \& Digital Systems (70%)** 



* **Daily Operations:** 
 Oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of our office at Vikhroli; manage housekeeping, supplies, and general upkeep.
* **Digital Architecture:** 
 Act as the primary administrator for
 **Google Workspace** 
 . This includes managing user access, structuring shared drives, and ensuring a clean, intuitive file\-naming hierarchy.
* **Vendor Management:** 
 Source, negotiate with, and manage vendors for office utilities, stationery, and equipment.
* **Logistics Support:** 
 Coordinate travel, local transport, and scheduling for the leadership team and visiting stakeholders.
* **Documentation:** 
 Maintain rigorous digital and physical filing systems to ensure "audit\-ready" documentation at all times.



  





**B. HR Operations(30%)** 



* **Talent Acquisition:** 
 Manage the full recruitment funnel—posting jobs, initial resume screening, scheduling interviews, and maintaining a candidate database.
* **Onboarding \& Exits:** 
 Ensure every new hire has a seamless Day 1 (IT setup, documentation, orientation) and manage professional offboarding for exiting employees.
* **Policy Implementation:** 
 Roll out HR policies and ensure consistent adherence across the team.
* **Performance Support:** 
 Assist the Head of Operations in tracking KRAs and ensuring timely completion of performance review cycles.
* **Compliance:** 
 Maintain employee records, attendance, and basic HR compliance requirements.



  





**3\. Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5–6 years of relevant HR \& Admin experience.
* Experience independently handling recruitment and HR operations.
* Prior experience in a startup, NGO, or small\-to\-mid\-sized education firm is highly preferred.



**Competencies** 



* **Execution Powerhouse:** 
 You don't just design processes; you enjoy the hands\-on work of implementing them.
* **Digital Fluency:** 
 Expert\-level command over Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar). You should be the person others ask for help with digital tools.
* **Organizational Hygiene:** 
 A natural knack for organizing files, schedules, and physical spaces.
* **Discretion:** 
 High integrity and emotional intelligence when handling sensitive employee information.



  





**Compensation** 




 Compensation will be competitive and based on experience and capability.

 Associates are the engine driving GLG's Insight Network – the world's largest and most varied source of first\-hand expertise. The Associate role involves fast\-paced communication, working directly as thought partners with leading professionals across industries for client deliverables.

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Note** 
 : This is an in\-office role based out of Mumbai, 6 days a week. An ideal candidate should have 7\-9 years of experience. Please apply if you meet the above criteria.
 



 HR Lead.
 



  





 Luma is building the future of fertility care in India — patient\-first, tech\-enabled, and unapologetically different from the clinical, impersonal experience that defines the category today. Backed by Peak XV, founded by a second\-time entrepreneur who has built and scaled before, Luma is past the idea stage and into the work of building a real organization around a real mission: better, more human healthcare for women, at scale.
 



 This role builds the people function from the ground up, inside a company trying to change what fertility care looks like in this country.
 



  





**What this role actually is** 




 Someone who can go from zero to one. You’ve built policy from nothing, set up payroll, made hiring work under real pressure. This is a hands\-on operator role — you do the work, not just direct others to do it. You’ll manage a small, growing team of your own.
 



 You’ll also design how the organization runs as it grows: clear roles, KRAs that mean something, a real sense of what good performance looks like at each level, and outcomes tied to the business as Luma expands into new clinics. Managing HR across a lean central team and a distributed, multi\-clinic footprint is core to this role, not an edge case.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




     •    HR infrastructure — policy, process, and systems built from scratch
 



     •    Payroll and compliance, run cleanly and on time
 



     •    Hiring — sourcing, screening, and closing roles fast, across head office and clinical functions
 



     •    Organization design — role clarity, KRAs, and performance frameworks that hold up as the company scales across multiple clinics
 



     •    Training and learning calendars, including clinical staff training
 



     •    Employee engagement across a central team and a clinic floor with a different operating rhythm
 



     •    Onboarding and the day\-to\-day discipline that keeps a growing, multi\-location team functioning
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 Real experience building HR inside an early\-stage, scaling startup, run lean and hands\-on. Healthcare, fertility care or clinic\-floor HR experience is a strong plus and will be prioritized.
 



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Fertility care in India has historically been clinical, transactional, and disempowering for the women going through it. Luma exists to change that — and the team you build, and the culture you set, will shape whether that mission is deliverable at scale. This is the chance to build the people foundation of a category\-defining, women\-led healthcare company early, not join one after the interesting decisions are already made.

 Talent Acquisition – Field HR
   

  

**Business Unit**
 Global Human Resources
   

  

**Job Grade**
**Location :**
 Sun House, Mumbai
   

  

 At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
 **Create your own sunshine”—** 
 by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
   

  

 Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?
   

  

 As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self\-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Talent Acquisition: \- Manage the full recruitment life cycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer rollout, and onboarding. Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements and candidate profiles. Develop sourcing strategies using job portals, social media, employee referrals, vendors, and networking. Conduct competency\-based interviews and facilitate assessment processes. Maintain recruitment metrics (TAT, quality of hire, source mix, pipeline). Build and manage talent pipelines for critical and future roles. Manage recruitment budgets and ensure cost\-effective hiring.
* Talent Management: \- Support during CPP process, conduct competency\-based interviews and facilitate assessment processes at various locations.
* Campus Hiring \& Employee Engagement: \- Plan and execute annual campus hiring strategy (B.Pharma, B.Sc., MBA, Diploma, and other institutes). Build and maintain strong relationships with colleges, TPOs, and placement committees. Coordinate pre\-placement talks, career fairs, assessments, and selection drives. Design onboarding and induction programs for campus hires, interns, and trainees. Manage internship programs, performance reviews. Manage internal communication channels for engagement and organizational updates.
* Induction \& Orientation: \- Completing the joining formalities of the selected candidates as per the company policy. developing an understanding of sun pharma benefits program and its competitive advantage in the market.


**Travel Estimate**
 Up to 40 %
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
 Graduate in any stream (Pref. B.SC./B.Pharm) \+ MBA (HR)
   

  

**Experience**
 8 – 10 Years, Exposure in TA / Campus Hiring
   

  

**Your Success Matters to Us**
 At Sun Pharma, your success and well\-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!
