title: HR Recruiter
description:
Dear Connections,
 



  





 WE’RE HIRING \| BUILD YOUR CAREER WITH KAMA JEWELRY! 💎
 



 ✨ Craft your future with us!
 



  





**Recruitment Executive – Manufacturing Workforce** 




**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented
 **Recruitment Executive – Manufacturing Workforce** 
 to support hiring for manufacturing, production, and shopfloor operations roles. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing quality talent, coordinating recruitment activities, and ensuring timely closure of positions in line with defined hiring timelines and service standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for manufacturing and shopfloor workforce positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, local networks, placement agencies, and vocational institutes.
* Screen and shortlist candidates based on job requirements and organizational fit.
* Coordinate interviews, candidate assessments, documentation, offer rollout, and onboarding activities.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SOPs, hiring processes, and defined turnaround times (TAT).
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.
* Follow up with candidates to ensure successful joining and minimize offer dropouts.
* Support walk\-in drives, bulk hiring initiatives, and recruitment campaigns as required.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.



**Key Skills** 



* Candidate Sourcing through Job Portals (Naukri/ ApnaJobs / IIMjobs etc) and Recruitment Channels
* Recruitment Coordination with Strong SOP \& Process Adherence
* Timely Position Closure with Focus on TAT Achievement



**Eligibility Criteria** 



* Graduate in any discipline.
* 6 months to 1 year of experience in recruitment, preferably in manufacturing workforce, shopfloor, operations, or volume hiring.
* Exposure to manufacturing or industrial environments will be preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and recruitment systems.

 sushil.sutar@kamajewelry.com

title: Talent Acquisition Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Recruiter to join our Global Capability Center in Mumbai. This role supports end\-to\-end recruiting activities, including sourcing, screening, pre\-employment, and onboarding, to ensure timely and high\-quality hiring outcomes. The Talent Acquisition Recruiter partners closely with HR Business Partners and hiring managers to identify, evaluate, and select candidates. The role also maintains accurate documentation and compliance with employment laws, coordinates background checks, prepares offers, and ensures a smooth onboarding experience for new hires.
 



  





**Essential Duties** 



* Collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to understand and support hiring needs
* Post job openings on internal and external platforms and execute sourcing strategies
* Develop sourcing plans and conduct targeted sourcing activities
* Define technical and behavioral selection criteria in partnership with HR Business Partners and hiring managers
* Conduct initial candidate screenings and assess candidate profiles
* Shortlist qualified candidates and present recommendations to interviewing managers
* Schedule interviews and oversee preparation of interview questions and other hiring and selection materials
* Ensure integrity of the Applicant Tracking System (Workday) through accurate maintenance of applicant documents, job descriptions, offer letters, forms, job requisitions, and applicant dispositions
* Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to develop, extend, and negotiate employment offers
* Generate and distribute offer letters, including required links and forms
* Maintain strong candidate communication throughout the hiring process, including acceptance and rejection notifications
* Initiate and review background checks and pre\-employment screening activities
* Coordinate onboarding documentation, equipment provisioning, and communications with appropriate internal teams



  





  





**Competencies** 



* Clearly and professionally communicates information, adapting messaging and style to suit diverse audiences, including candidates, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders
* Builds positive, respectful relationships with candidates and business partners and collaborates effectively across cross\-functional teams
* Demonstrates a strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment processes
* Conducts structured interviews and candidate screenings to accurately assess qualifications, fit, and potential
* Effectively partners with hiring managers and business leaders, demonstrating strong follow\-through and accountability
* Delivers a high\-quality experience for candidates and hiring managers through responsiveness, professionalism, and care
* Successfully manages multiple positions simultaneously while meeting deadlines and quality expectations
* Consistently follows established processes and ensures adherence to legal, regulatory, and organizational compliance standards

 This job description indicates in general terms, the type and level of work performed as well as the typical responsibilities of employees in this classification and it may be changed by management at any time. Other duties may also apply. Nothing in this job description changes the at\-will employment relationship existing between the Company and its employees.

description:
**Job description:** 




**Job Description: HR Executive** 




**Location: Andheri East** 




  





**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Website Link: https://realatte.com / https://logicloop.io/** 




  





**Position Summary:** 




  





 The HR Executive at Realatte Ventures will play a critical role in building the company’s talent pool by managing the full recruitment life cycle. You will be responsible for identifying and attracting top talent, managing candidate relationships, and working closely with hiring managers to meet the company’s staffing needs. This role requires a strategic mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for finding the best fit for every role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Full\-Cycle Recruitment: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes for various roles within the company, from entry\-level to senior positions.



  




* Talent Sourcing: Use diverse channels such as job boards, social media, networking events, and recruitment agencies to identify potential candidates.



  




* Screening and Interviewing: Conduct initial screening calls, schedule interviews, and coordinate assessments to evaluate candidates’ skills, experience, and cultural fit.



  




* Collaboration with Hiring Managers: Work closely with department heads and hiring managers to understand staffing needs and ensure alignment with business goals.



  




* Candidate Experience: Ensure a smooth and positive experience for all candidates throughout the recruitment process, maintaining timely communication and providing feedback.



  




* Offer Management: Extend job offers, negotiate salaries, and finalize terms of employment with selected candidates.



  




* Recruitment Metrics: Track and report on recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, and quality of hire to evaluate recruitment effectiveness.



  




* Employer Branding: Assist in developing strategies for promoting the company's employer brand and enhancing the candidate pipeline.



  




* Onboarding: Collaborate with HR and other departments to ensure successful onboarding of new hires.



  




* Recruitment Strategies: Stay updated on industry trends and continuously improve recruitment processes and strategies to attract top talent.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment strategies, techniques, and best practices.
* Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple recruitment projects simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge of employment laws and regulations related to hiring and recruitment.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Research & Operations Executive - Executive Search
description:
Research \& Operations Executive – Executive Search
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Executive Search \& Recruitment
 



**Company:** 
 Core Sync
   





 About Core Sync
 



  





 Core Sync is an
 **Executive Search and Recruitment firm** 
 specializing in talent acquisition across the legal industry. We partner with leading
 **law firms, corporate legal teams, and in\-house legal departments** 
 to identify and connect with professionals across different levels and practice areas.
 



 We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and confident
 **Research \& Operations Executive** 
 to support our executive search and recruitment operations. This is a hands\-on role involving
 **market research, talent mapping, candidate outreach, cold calling, database management, market intelligence, and operational coordination** 
 .
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of data as well as communicating directly with candidates, Partners, senior professionals, and other stakeholders.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Research \& Talent Mapping** 



* Conduct detailed research for ongoing executive search and recruitment mandates.
* Map relevant professionals across law firms, companies, industries, locations, and practice areas.
* Identify potential candidates using LinkedIn and other research platforms.
* Conduct market and competitor research to support different search assignments.
* Gather and maintain relevant
 **market intelligence** 
 for the recruitment team.



**Candidate Outreach \& Calling** 



* Conduct regular
 **cold calling and candidate outreach** 
 for active mandates.
* Speak confidently and professionally with candidates, including
 **Partners and senior\-level professionals** 
 .
* Conduct initial conversations to understand candidates’ experience, current roles, practice areas, interest levels, compensation, notice periods, and career expectations.
* Follow up consistently with prospective candidates and maintain engagement throughout the process.



**Database \& Excel Management** 



* Build, maintain, and continuously update
 **large candidate databases and market\-mapping sheets** 
 .
* Work extensively on
 **Microsoft Excel** 
 to organize, filter, maintain, and track large volumes of information.
* Ensure candidate information, call status, follow\-ups, and recruitment progress are updated accurately.
* Maintain clean, structured, and reliable data for ongoing and future search mandates.
* Regularly review databases to identify missing, outdated, or incomplete information.



**Operations \& Coordination** 



* Support day\-to\-day operational activities related to recruitment assignments.
* Coordinate candidate interviews, calls, meetings, and follow\-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and ensure timely updates across ongoing mandates.
* Work closely with recruiters and consultants to ensure smooth execution of assignments.
* Handle multiple search mandates, candidate conversations, databases, and follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Ensure tasks are completed within agreed timelines and maintain strong follow\-through.



  





 Key Requirements
 



  




* **2–5 years of professional experience** 
 in Recruitment, Executive Search, Research, Operations, Consulting, Business Development, or a similar role.
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential.**
* Strong research, talent\-mapping, and market\-intelligence capabilities.
* Comfortable with
 **cold calling and high\-volume candidate outreach** 
 .
* Confidence in communicating with
 **Partners, senior professionals, and leadership\-level candidates** 
 .
* Strong proficiency in
 **Microsoft Excel** 
 and experience handling large datasets.
* Ability to
 **manage, organize, and continuously update large databases** 
 with accuracy.
* Excellent attention to detail and data\-management skills.
* Strong
 **multitasking and time\-management abilities** 
 .
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong coordination, follow\-up, and organizational skills.
* Proactive, responsible, and comfortable working in a
 **fast\-paced and execution\-driven environment** 
 .



  





  





 Preferred Profile
 



 Prior experience in
 **Executive Search or Recruitment** 
 would be an advantage, particularly for candidates who have worked on research, candidate mapping, sourcing, calling, or recruitment operations.
 



  





 However, candidates from
 **Research, Consulting, Business Development, Operations, or other relevant industries** 
 who possess strong communication, research, calling, and data\-management skills are also encouraged to apply.
   





 Apply
 



 If you enjoy
 **researching markets, connecting with professionals, working with data, and managing multiple priorities** 
 , we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Sr. Director / AVP – Talent Acquisition (Volume Hiring)
description:
Digitide (Quess GTS) is an AI\-first, digital\-native solutions provider, we are focused on enabling enterprise success through comprehensive digital transformation. Our expertise encompasses Digital IT Services, Platforms, Business Processes and Cloud Infrastructure, offering cutting\-edge and scalable technologies that drive business efficiency, enhance customer experience and grow customer revenue. Digitide (Quess GTS) specializes in delivering end\-to\-end IT and business process services tailored to meet the complex needs of industries like insurance, finance and healthcare.
 



  





 Job Title: Sr. Director / AVP – TAG
 



 Department: Human Resources
 



 Location: Mumbai, Airoli
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an accomplished Sr. Director / AVP – TAG for BPO \& Frontline Hiring to lead large\-scale talent acquisition and workforce delivery for high\-volume frontline operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for building and executing a scalable hiring strategy across multiple locations, with a strong focus on volume hiring, frontline recruitment, staffing productivity, recruitment operations, cost optimization, and joining/retention outcomes. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in BPO/BPM, contact center, customer service, sales, collections, back\-office or other high\-volume environments, and should be comfortable managing large recruitment teams and aggressive hiring targets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Talent Acquisition Strategy** 




 • Own the overall frontline and bulk hiring strategy aligned with business growth and workforce
 



 requirements.
 



 • Translate manpower plans into monthly/quarterly hiring targets and recruitment capacity requirements.
 



 • Build scalable recruitment models to support rapid ramp\-ups, new processes and large client
 



 transitions.
 



 • Drive innovative sourcing strategies across digital, referral, walk\-in, campus, local hiring and community channels.
 



  





**2\. Bulk \& Frontline Hiring** 




 • Lead high\-volume hiring for customer service, voice/non\-voice, sales, collections, back\-office and other frontline roles.
 



 • Manage hiring targets ranging from hundreds to several thousand positions depending on business requirements.
 



 • Build strong talent pipelines across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane and other key hiring markets.
 



 • Improve offer\-to\-join, selection\-to\-join and joining\-to\-retention ratios.
 



  





**3\. Recruitment Operations** 




 • Lead large recruitment teams, including TA managers, recruiters, sourcing teams, interview teams and recruitment coordinators.
 



 • Establish recruitment productivity benchmarks and daily/weekly operating rhythms.
 



 • Build dashboards covering funnel metrics, recruiter productivity, source effectiveness, TAT and hiring costs.
 



 • Standardize recruitment processes, SOPs and governance mechanisms across locations.
 



  





**4\. Stakeholder Management** 




 • Partner closely with Business Heads, Operations, Workforce Management, Finance and HR to ensure hiring plans are delivered on time.
 



 • Act as the senior HR/TA partner for large\-scale workforce ramp\-ups.
 



 • Provide regular MIS, hiring forecasts, risk assessment and corrective\-action plans to the leadership team.
 



  





**5\. Recruitment Cost \& Vendor Management** 




 • Optimize cost\-per\-hire through effective channel mix and sourcing strategy.
 



 • Manage recruitment partners, manpower consultants, job portals, sourcing agencies and local hiring partners.
 



 • Negotiate and govern vendor SLAs, commercials and performance metrics.
 



 • Drive greater reliance on direct sourcing and employee referral channels wherever appropriate.
 



  





**6\. Technology \& Process Excellence** 




 • Leverage ATS, recruitment CRM, AI/digital sourcing and analytics to improve recruitment efficiency.
 



 • Develop data\-driven hiring models and predictive recruitment dashboards.
 



 • Continuously improve recruitment TAT, candidate experience and recruiter productivity.
 



 • Introduce automation across screening, scheduling, communication and recruitment MIS.
 



  





**7\. Quality, Compliance \& Candidate Experience** 




 • Ensure adherence to recruitment policies, documentation and background verification requirements.
 



 • Maintain strong recruitment quality and reduce early attrition caused by hiring mismatches.
 



 • Drive a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
 



 • Ensure recruitment practices are compliant with applicable employment regulations and organizational policies.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 • Monthly / quarterly hiring achievement
 



 • Offer\-to\-joining ratio
 



 • Selection\-to\-joining ratio
 



 • Time\-to\-hire / Time\-to\-fill
 



 • Cost per hire
 



 • Recruiter productivity
 



 • Source\-wise conversion
 



 • Early attrition / 30\-60\-90\-day retention
 



 • Quality of hire
 



 • Vendor productivity and cost
 



 • Recruitment TAT
 



 • Hiring forecast accuracy
 



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in human resource, Business Administration, or related field. MBA or equivalent
 



 preferred.
 



 • 15\+ years of progressive HR experience with at least 5 years in a strategic Recruitment.
 



 • Experience in \[industry, e.g., BPM, ITES, manufacturing, IT, healthcare, etc.] is a plus.
 



  





**Key Skills and Competencies:** 




 • Strong business acumen with the ability to align HR strategies to business goals.
 



 • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • High emotional intelligence and conflict resolution capabilities.
 



 • Expertise in organizational development and talent management.
 



 • Proficiency in HRIS and analytics tools.
 



  





**Work Environment and Conditions:** 




 • Full\-time position with occasional travel to regional offices or worksites.
 



  





**Soft Skills:** 




 • Strong business acumen and ability to align HR strategies with company objectives.
 



 • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to handle sensitive employee issues with discretion and professionalism.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 • Opportunity to shape the strategic direction of a leading organization.
 



 • Work in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Competitive compensation package and benefits.
 



 • A collaborative and innovative corporate culture

Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

 The Client Servicing professional will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day relationships with clients, ensuring smooth manpower deployment and operations, and coordinating with internal recruitment, HR, payroll and compliance teams to deliver agreed staffing services effectively.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR INTERN
 



  





 \*Company:\* Trance Interiors LLP
 



 \*Department:\* Human Resources
 



 \*Position:\* HR Intern
 



 \*Location:\* Thane West, Mumbai
 



 \*Employment Type:\* Internship
 



 \*Reporting To:\* HR Executive / HR Manager
 



  





  





  





  1\. JOB PURPOSE
 



  





 The HR Intern will support the HR Department in day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, attendance management, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR process development.
 



  





 The intern will gain practical exposure to various HR functions while assisting the HR team in maintaining an organized, professional, and employee\-friendly workplace.
 



  





  





  





  2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  A. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 



  





 \* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, references, and other recruitment channels.
 



 \* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate with candidates regarding interview schedules.
 



 \* Conduct initial communication with candidates.
 



 \* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Follow up with candidates regarding interview attendance and joining status.
 



 \* Coordinate interview schedules with the concerned department heads.
 



 \* Maintain records of shortlisted, rejected, selected, and joined candidates.
 



 \* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, internship letters, and other HR documents.
 



  





 B. Employee Onboarding
 



  





 \* Coordinate the joining process for new employees.
 



 \* Collect and verify required employee documents.
 



 \* Maintain employee personal and employment records.
 



 \* Assist in preparing joining forms and onboarding checklists.

**Job Description – Talent Acquisition (Cold chain Industry)** 




**Position:** 

 Head – Human Resources (HR Head)

 Human Resources

 Mumbai (Goregaon)

 10–15 Years

 Full\-Time
 




**About Crystal Group** 





 Crystal Group is one of India's leading integrated Cold Chain and Logistics Solution providers with over 60 years of industry excellence. We specialize in temperature\-controlled warehousing, reefer transportation, portable cold storage containers, cold room projects, and end\-to\-end supply chain solutions across India. At Crystal Group, we believe our people are our greatest strength, and we are committed to building a high\-performance, innovation\-driven, and employee\-centric workplace.
 




**Role Purpose** 





 The Head of Human Resources will lead the complete HR function for Crystal Group by developing and executing people strategies that support business growth and organizational excellence. This role is responsible for Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Performance Management, Employee Engagement, Learning \& Development, Compliance, Payroll Governance, HR Analytics, and Organizational Development.
 





 The ideal candidate should be a strategic HR leader with strong business acumen, capable of building scalable HR systems, driving organizational culture, improving employee productivity, and partnering closely with business leaders.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**HR Strategy \& Business Partnering** 



* Develop and execute the organization's HR strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Partner with senior leadership to drive organizational growth and workforce planning.
* Design and implement HR policies, frameworks, and best practices.
* Lead organizational restructuring and change management initiatives.



**Talent Acquisition** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for all business verticals and leadership positions.
* Develop hiring strategies to reduce recruitment turnaround time.
* Build talent pipelines through multiple sourcing channels.
* Strengthen employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives.



**Performance Management** 



* Design and implement KPI, KRA, and Performance Management Systems.
* Drive annual and quarterly performance appraisal cycles.
* Support leadership in succession planning and talent reviews.
* Implement performance improvement initiatives across departments.



**HR Operations** 



* Oversee onboarding, confirmations, promotions, transfers, exits, and employee lifecycle management.
* Ensure accuracy of employee records through HRMS.
* Supervise payroll inputs, attendance, leave management, and HR documentation.
* Standardize HR processes across all business locations.



**Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Develop employee engagement initiatives to improve retention.
* Drive employee communication and recognition programs.
* Manage employee grievance handling and disciplinary matters.
* Build a positive, inclusive, and performance\-driven work culture.



**Learning \& Development** 



* Identify competency gaps and training needs.
* Develop leadership development programs.
* Organize technical, behavioral, and functional training.
* Measure training effectiveness through performance outcomes.



**Compliance \& Governance** 



* Ensure compliance with Labour Laws, Shops \& Establishment Act, PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, POSH, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct HR audits and maintain statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with legal consultants and government authorities whenever required.



**HR Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Develop HR dashboards and management reports.
* Monitor hiring, attrition, employee productivity, and engagement metrics.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations to leadership for workforce planning.



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strategic HR Leadership
* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* HR Operations
* Performance Management System (KPI/KRA)
* Employee Engagement
* Organizational Development
* Learning \& Development
* Payroll Governance
* Labour Law Compliance
* HRMS \& HR Analytics
* Change Management
* Leadership \& Team Building
* Stakeholder Management
* Conflict Resolution
* Excellent Communication \& Interpersonal Skills



**Educational Qualification** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources (Preferred)
* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline
* HR Certifications will be an added advantage



**Experience Required** 



* 10–15 years of progressive HR experience.
* Minimum 5 years in an HR leadership role.
* Experience in Logistics, Cold Chain, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, Engineering, or Supply Chain industries preferred.
* Experience managing multi\-location HR operations.



**Why Join Crystal Group?** 



* At Crystal Group, you will have the opportunity to lead the HR function of one of India's fastest\-growing cold chain organizations. You will work directly with senior leadership to build a high\-performing workforce, shape organizational culture, drive digital HR transformation, and contribute to the company's long\-term growth and success. We offer a collaborative work environment, challenging opportunities, and a platform for continuous professional growth.

 Pharmacy and consumables — stock levels, procurement, vendor management, and cost control

 Coordination with our rescue helpline and ambulance dispatch for incoming emergency cases
 



 Handling donors, visitors, and walk\-in public with patience and clarity
 



 Facility upkeep, statutory compliance, and biomedical waste protocols
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



  





 Graduate or postgraduate; qualification in hospital / healthcare administration is a plus
 



 3\+ years managing a hospital, clinic, or a multi\-person operations team
 



 Strong people management — this is a floor role, not a desk role
 



 Comfort with digital systems: records, dashboards, WhatsApp coordination, basic reporting
 



 Fluency in Hindi and English; Marathi or Gujarati an advantage
 



 Calm under pressure, and genuine comfort around animals in distress
 



  





 What we offer
 



  





 Salary as per experience
 



 Full\-time, on\-site role in Ghatkopar, Mumbai
 



 Accommodation support for outstation candidates (on discussion)
 



 A chance to build the systems of a growing hospital from the ground up, within a national rescue network

**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.**
 Our People \& Culture and Legal teams make sure we provide a highly ethical working environment where everyone at Priceline can bring their whole selves to work and deliver their very best each day. We want you to thrive – to feel safe, supported, valued, and growing to your highest potential!
   

  

**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 This is an exciting opportunity to build and shape the future of our Mumbai office OR COMPANY FOR NON MUMBAI ROLES. You will be fueling our growth and help us scale by recruiting a world class team of professionals as well as providing outstanding experience to candidates.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Get To**
* Lead full\-cycle recruiting for Tech / Non tech roles
* Apply your passion for direct sourcing and experience with multiple tools and established networks
* Drive and implement innovative strategies for pipeline generation of diverse talent to our core and niche roles, as well as our critical \& recurring roles
* Lead recruitment status meetings with hiring managers and functional client contacts
* Partner with your peers on the People and Culture team (Talent, Talent Acquisition, Operations, Compensation \& Benefits, and Facilities) throughout the recruitment life\-cycle to ensure a seamless candidate / new hire experience
* Apply your sense of urgency to achieve in meeting quarterly goals: hires per quarter, time\-to\-fill, candidate pipelines and required applicant tracking system updates


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s Degree or Higher in Human Resources or related field
* 5\-7 years of professional experience providing full life cycle corporate recruitment or in a RPO model
* Accomplished leader in recruiting across all levels and functions
* Proven success with leveraging employer branding, candidate sourcing, interviewing, assessment, offer positioning and closing
* Self\-starter, able to adjust to changing priorities, and can operate effectively amidst ambiguity
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.


**\# LIHybrid**
**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
   

  

**Flexible work at Priceline**
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
   

  

**Perks \& Benefits At Priceline**
 Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
   

  

**Health \& wellness coverage** 
 including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
   

  

**Generous time off** 
 including PTO, holidays, a company\-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
   

  

**Work/life support** 
 including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
   

  

**Financial security programs** 
 such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax\-advantaged accounts
   

  

**Signature travel perks** 
 including employee\-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
   

  

**Additional perks \& discounts** 
 like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
   

  

**A people\-first culture** 
 with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
   

  

*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
 To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
   

  

 Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

 **current employees**

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**Great teams begin with someone who knows how to find great people.** 




  





**We’re hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager for Walnut Advertising and Imago \& Getter.** 
  Look beyond a CV to find genuine talent and help the right candidate see the opportunity. We need an experienced, hands\-on recruitment professional to manage hiring across our two businesses.
 



  





**THE ROLE AT A GLANCE** 




 Location: Head Office, Ghatkopar, Mumbai
 



 Employment: Full\-time, work from office
 



 Working days: Monday to Friday
 



 Compensation: Up to ₹75,000/\- \+ Incentives
 



 Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands\-on recruitment experience.
 



  





**TWO BUSINESSES. DIFFERENT HIRING CHALLENGES. MEANINGFUL RESPONSIBILITY.** 




**Walnut Advertising** 
  works across creative communication, branding and advertising—where finding the right talent means understanding creativity, client relationships and execution.
 



  





**Imago \& Getter** 
  operates in disinfection and contamination\-control solutions—where hiring requires an appreciation of technical knowledge, customer needs and commercial capability.
 



  





 You’ll help both businesses find people who can contribute, grow and make a difference.
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 




 ·       
 **Understand the requirement:** 
  Collaborate with business leaders to define the success criteria for each role.
 



 ·       
 **Identify suitable candidates:** 
  Create a robust pipeline by using LinkedIn, referrals, professional networks, job portals, and direct contact.
 



 ·       
 **Evaluate candidates’ abilities:** 
  Discuss their work, contributions, and achievements in structured conversations and assessments.
 



 ·       
 **Manage the entire hiring process:** 
  From screening and interviews to offer discussions and follow\-through, until the candidate joins.
 



 ·       
 **Inform and engage candidates:** 
  Introduce them to our work, people, and opportunity clearly.
 



 ·       
 **Bring discipline to recruitment:** 
  Maintain useful hiring reports, identify bottlenecks and track offer acceptance, joining and early retention.
 



  





**WHO WE’D LIKE TO MEET** 




 ·       You have at least five years of substantive recruitment experience and can talk us through difficult positions you have personally filled.
 



 ·       You know how to actively approach suitable candidates, ask thoughtful questions and assess whether their experience matches the requirement.
 



 ·       You can manage competing priorities, maintain momentum with hiring managers and have honest conversations about compensation and expectations.
 



 ·       Experience recruiting for advertising, creative, sales, business development, pharma, healthcare or other B2B roles will be an advantage.
 



 ·       You don’t need experience in every one of these areas, but you should be curious enough to understand unfamiliar roles.
 



  





**WHY JOIN US?** 




 This is an opportunity to take visible ownership of hiring across two distinct businesses. You’ll work closely with business heads, help improve hiring decisions and shape an engaging recruitment experience. Your contribution will be reflected in the people and teams you help bring together.
 



 If you enjoy responsibility, variety and seeing the outcome of your work, we’d like to meet you.
 



  





**A CONVERSATION THAT GOES BOTH WAYS** 




 We want you to understand us as well as we understand you.
 



 Our selection process will include an introduction to our businesses and work, a discussion of your actual hiring achievements and a short practical recruitment scenario. There will also be time for your questions about the role, expectations and working here.
 



  





**INTERESTED?** 




 Send me a direct message on LinkedIn with:
 



 • Your CV or LinkedIn profile
 



 • One brief example of a challenging position you personally filled—what made it difficult, what you did and the outcome
 



 • Your expected compensation and notice period
 



 • Confirmation that working from our Ghatkopar office, Monday to Friday, suits you
 



  





 Please keep examples anonymous and avoid sharing confidential candidate or employer information.
 



 Know someone who would be a good fit? Please share this opportunity with them.

**About Boston Institute of Analytics** 




 The Boston Institute of Analytics is one of the top\-ranked international education and training institutes, headquartered in Boston, USA, with 107 campuses across 7\+ countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, South Africa, and India. BIA delivers industry\-leading programs across new\-age technical and non\-technical disciplines, helping students and professionals build future\-ready careers in the world's most in\-demand fields.  .

 · Track companies that regularly hire from BIA.
 



 · Identify opportunities to develop long\-term hiring relationships.
 



 · Maintain a database of previous recruiters for future hiring requirements.
 



  





**Reporting \& MIS**

 o HR/recruiter connections
 



 o Active hiring requirements
 



 o Candidates submitted
 



 o Interviews scheduled
 



 o Candidates shortlisted
 



 o Offers received
 



 o Students placed

 · Excellent follow\-up and coordination abilities.

 Candidates with

**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 Boston Institute of Analytics is committed to fair and inclusive hiring practices. All qualified candidates will be considered based on their skills, experience, communication abilities, and suitability for the role.

 As our client grows both its clinic footprint and its business teams (sales, marketing, finance, ops, HR), hiring needs span a wide range of functions and seniority levels at once. description:
**About the Role:** 




 The Technical Recruiter will be responsible for end\-to\-end hiring delivery of technology and support roles for:
 


* Arcot Group companies – Arcitech.ai, AllTalent.com, Haire.ai, ProSchool.ai and other internal projects.
* External client mandates that require tech talent and support staff.



 This is a hands\-on, target\-driven role focused on active, outbound sourcing – not just processing incoming applications.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 You will:
 


* Own the recruitment lifecycle for assigned roles – from intake to joining.
* Focus mainly on tech positions while also handling non\-tech/support hiring depending on business needs.
* Spend a significant portion of your time on proactive sourcing via LinkedIn, job portals, and communities, rather than only relying on direct applicants.
* Work closely with the Recruitment Manager and hiring managers to close positions within agreed timelines and quality standards.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Requirement Understanding \& Role Briefing
 


* Attend detailed intake meetings with the Recruitment Manager / hiring managers to understand:
* Tech stack, tools, and frameworks required
* Must\-have vs good\-to\-have skills
* Experience range, budget, and location preferences
* Role context, reporting, and career growth
* Ask clarifying questions where needed and ensure screening criteria and search strategy are clearly defined before sourcing.



  





 2\. Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Building
 


* Take full ownership of active sourcing, not just processing applicants from posted jobs.
* Use LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, and other job portals extensively to identify and reach out to relevant candidates.
* Build and continuously refine Boolean search strings and advanced search filters to narrow down to the right profiles quickly.
* Proactively send connection requests, InMails, emails, and job portal messages to targeted candidates with tailored outreach, followed by systematic follow\-ups.
* Tap into multiple channels beyond job boards:
* Employee and external referrals
* GitHub / Stack Overflow and other tech communities
* WhatsApp/Telegram groups, alumni networks, meetups, and online forums
* Build and maintain role\-wise talent pools for recurring roles such as:
* Developers (frontend, backend, full\-stack, mobile)
* DevOps / Cloud / SRE
* Data / AI / ML engineers
* QA / Automation testers
* Product and business analysts
* Support roles (operations, customer success, sales, marketing, etc.)
* Ensure all sourcing activity and candidate touchpoints are logged accurately in the ATS / trackers.



  





 3\. Screening \& Assessment
 


* Conduct initial telephonic / video screening to evaluate:
* Technical skills and relevant stack exposure
* Complexity and relevance of previous projects
* Communication skills and cultural fit
* Alignment with compensation, notice period, location, and work setup expectations
* Coordinate technical assessments / coding tests / assignments as required and follow up for completion.
* Quickly calibrate profiles with the Recruitment Manager / hiring managers by sharing a first batch of sourced candidates and aligning on what “good” looks like.
* Present shortlisted candidates with structured notes (skills summary, notice period, CTC, reasons for fit, potential risks).



  





 4\. Interview Coordination \& Process Management
 


* Schedule interviews with internal stakeholders and/or clients, sharing clear information with candidates (role, panel, format).
* Ensure interviewers have updated resumes, your screening notes, and any test results in advance.
* Keep candidates informed about timelines, feedback expectations, and next steps.
* Collect and record structured feedback from interviewers; update ATS/trackers promptly.
* Escalate bottlenecks or delays to the Recruitment Manager and propose solutions (parallel pipelines, wider search, adjusted criteria, etc.).



  





 5\. Offer Management \& Joining
 


* Support the Recruitment Manager / HR in preparing offer details / CTC structures.
* Clearly explain offer components to candidates and handle queries around salary structure, benefits, and role expectations.
* Manage offer negotiation within guidelines and keep candidates engaged until joining (check\-ins, documentation support, pre\-joining engagement).
* Coordinate with HR operations / onboarding for smooth joining – documentation, systems access, induction schedules.



  





 6\. ATS, Reporting \& Documentation
 


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the ATS / trackers – including stages, notes, and communication history.
* Track and report your sourcing funnel metrics, including:



 Profiles identified → contacted → responded → screened → shortlisted → interviewed → offered → joined.
 


* Clearly mark candidates as sourced vs applied to help measure outbound impact.
* Share weekly updates with the Recruitment Manager on open roles, pipeline health, risks, and suggested corrective actions.



  





 7\. Market Intelligence \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Stay updated on tech recruitment trends, salary benchmarks, demand\-supply patterns, and competitor hiring.
* Share market feedback on challenging roles, skill shortages, or unrealistic expectations with the Recruitment Manager for calibration.
* Suggest improvements in JDs, search strategy, interview process, assessments, and candidate engagement based on your daily experience.



  





**Key Skills \& Requirements:** 



* Graduate (any discipline); specialization in HR / IT / related fields is an advantage.
* 2–5 years of experience in technical recruitment / IT staffing, preferably in a tech/startup or staffing / consulting environment.
* Strong comfort with hiring for tech roles (developers, data, QA, DevOps, product, etc.) and willingness to handle non\-tech/support roles as needed.
* Hands\-on experience in proactive sourcing using:
* LinkedIn (including advanced search techniques)
* Major job portals such as Indeed, Naukri, and others
* Boolean search and keyword strategies
* Good understanding of common tech skills and terminology (e.g Python, React, Node, microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL/NoSQL, etc.).
* Structured, process\-oriented working style with strong documentation and follow\-through.
* Strong communication and candidate engagement skills; ability to build rapport quickly.
* Comfortable working with targets, SLAs, and multiple simultaneous open roles.
* High ownership, persistence, and ability to work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

title: Information Technology Recruiter
description:
Technology Recruiter – India
 
  





**Location:** 
 India
 



**Company:** 
 Inspire Talent
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Recruitment Manager / Head of Talent
   




 About Inspire Talent
 
  





 Inspire Talent is a UK\-headquartered technology consultancy and talent solutions business supporting clients across the UK, US, Europe and other international markets.
 



 We help organisations attract, develop and retain high\-quality technology talent through specialist recruitment, consulting resources and our Academy / Hire\-Train\-Deploy programmes.
 



  





 Our technology recruitment spans areas including:
 



  




* Software Engineering
* Data Engineering \& Analytics
* Cloud \& DevOps
* AI \& Machine Learning
* SAP
* ServiceNow
* Snowflake
* Salesforce
* Financial Markets Technology
* Other specialist and niche technology roles



  





 We are looking for an ambitious
 **Technology Recruiter** 
 to join our growing recruitment team in India and support hiring across our international client base.
 



  




 The Role
 
  





 As a Technology Recruiter, you will be responsible for identifying, engaging and managing high\-quality candidates across a range of technology disciplines.
 



 This is an end\-to\-end recruitment role. You will work closely with our recruitment, sales and delivery teams to understand client requirements, develop sourcing strategies and build strong pipelines of candidates.
 



 You will recruit across both experienced technology professionals and, where required, graduate and early\-career talent for Inspire Talent's Academy programmes.
 



 The successful candidate will be proactive, commercially aware and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where candidate quality and speed of delivery are equally important.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  




 Candidate Sourcing \& Recruitment
 
  




* Manage the recruitment lifecycle from initial sourcing through to interview, offer and onboarding.
* Proactively source candidates using LinkedIn, job boards, internal databases, referrals and other recruitment channels.
* Conduct structured screening calls to assess technical experience, communication skills, motivations, salary expectations and availability.
* Build talent pipelines for current and anticipated client requirements.
* Develop expertise within key technology markets and understand where relevant talent can be found.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.


 Technology Recruitment
 
  





 Recruit across a range of technical disciplines, potentially including:
 



  




* Java, Python, C\# and software engineering
* Data Engineering, SQL, Spark, Databricks and Kafka
* AWS, Azure and GCP
* DevOps, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform
* AI / Machine Learning
* Snowflake
* SAP
* ServiceNow
* Salesforce
* Financial Markets and banking technology



 You do not need to be an expert across every technology, but you should be comfortable learning technical terminology and understanding the difference between candidate profiles.
   




 Client \& Delivery Support
 
  




* Work closely with Account Managers and the wider recruitment team to understand client requirements.
* Translate job specifications into effective candidate search strategies.
* Present strong candidate shortlists with clear, concise candidate summaries.
* Coordinate interviews and manage candidate feedback.
* Support offer negotiations and candidate closing.
* Identify potential recruitment challenges early and communicate these to the wider team.
* Deliver against agreed recruitment targets and client deadlines.



  




 Academy \& Graduate Recruitment
 
  





 Inspire Talent operates technology Academy programmes where graduates and early\-career professionals are recruited, assessed and trained before deployment to clients.
 



 The recruiter may support:
 


* Graduate and early\-career candidate sourcing.
* High\-volume recruitment campaigns.
* Initial competency and motivation screening.
* Coordination of technical assessments.
* Candidate assessment days and interview processes.
* Building talent pools ahead of future Academy programmes.
* Ensuring candidates understand the training, deployment and longer\-term career opportunity.


 What We Are Looking ForEssential
 * 2–5 years' experience within recruitment or talent acquisition.
* Experience recruiting technology or IT professionals.
* Strong candidate sourcing skills, particularly through LinkedIn and job boards.
* Experience conducting candidate screening and qualification calls.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and candidate processes simultaneously.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with international colleagues and clients.
* Target\-driven with a strong sense of ownership and urgency.


 Desirable
 
 Experience recruiting within one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:
 


* Banking or Financial Services technology
* Software Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Cloud / DevOps
* SAP
* ServiceNow
* Snowflake
* Salesforce
* Graduate technology recruitment
* International recruitment, particularly UK, US or European markets


 What Good Looks Like
 
 We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply searching CV databases.
 



 A successful recruiter at Inspire Talent will:
 


* Understand the requirement before starting a search.
* Proactively headhunt rather than relying solely on applicants.
* Speak confidently with technology professionals.
* Qualify candidates properly before presenting them.
* Build relationships and maintain candidate pipelines.
* Communicate clearly when a search is proving difficult.
* Work collaboratively with sales, account management and delivery teams.
* Take ownership of vacancies from initial briefing through to successful placement.
* Represent Inspire Talent professionally in every candidate interaction.


 Key Performance Indicators
 
 Performance will typically be measured across:
 


* Qualified candidates submitted.
* Candidate\-to\-interview conversion.
* Interview\-to\-offer conversion.
* Successful placements.
* Time to shortlist / time to hire.
* Candidate pipeline development.
* Quality and accuracy of candidate information.
* Candidate engagement and offer acceptance.
* Delivery against individual and team recruitment targets.


 Why Join Inspire Talent?
 
 This is an opportunity to join a growing international technology talent business rather than a traditional volume recruitment environment.
 



 You will have exposure to specialist technology markets, international clients and different talent solutions ranging from experienced recruitment through to large\-scale Academy and workforce programmes.
 



 Inspire Talent's model combines recruitment with technical assessment, training, certification and ongoing candidate development, giving our recruitment team the opportunity to build longer\-term careers as well as make individual placements.
   




 The Opportunity
 
  





 We are looking for someone who wants to develop with the business.
 



  




* For the right person, there will be opportunities to take greater responsibility for particular technology markets, client accounts and recruitment programmes as Inspire Talent continues to grow internationally.

title: Talent Acquisition Head
description:
**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




  





 Monarch Networth Capital has grown from ₹2 Crore PAT to ₹181 Crore PAT in six years. Our networth has crossed ₹1,000 Crore. We have built 8 fast growing business verticals from the ground up. And we have achieved this with one belief, the right people, in the right roles, with the right ownership, can build anything.
 



 But here is the truth: our growth has outpaced our ability to hire at the speed and quality we need. We are hiring across every vertical: Retail Broking, Investment Banking, Institutional Equities, AIF, PMS, Wealth Management, Compliance, Technology, and our upcoming AMC. Each role demands a specific kind of person \- not just qualified, but entrepreneurial. Not just experienced, but hungry.
 



 We don't need an HR recruiter. We need a Talent Acquisition Head who thinks like a CEO, someone who understands that every hire either accelerates or slows down the company, and treats recruitment with that level of seriousness.
 



  





**THE MONARCH CONTEXT — WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT** 




  





 This is not a 10,000\-employee company where hiring is a volume game. This is a high growth, high conviction platform where every hire is visible, every person matters.
 



  





 A few things you should know before you apply:
 



 ▸
 **Lowest attrition rate in the industry.** 
 People don't leave Monarch. Your job is to ensure the people who join are the reason others stay, not the reason they leave.
 



  





 ▸
 **8 verticals, each with distinct hiring needs.** 
 A Research Analyst is a fundamentally different hire from a Deal Originator or a Compliance Head. You need to understand every business deeply enough to know what "great" looks like in each role.
 



  





 ▸
 **We have never hired through advertising.** 
 Every senior hire has come through networks, referrals, and direct outreach. You need to build and own those pipelines.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\. Talent Strategy \& Planning** 




 ▸ Own the entire talent acquisition function end\-to\-end, from workforce planning and JD creation to sourcing, screening, offer negotiation, and onboarding handoff.
 



  





 ▸ Work directly with the CEO and business heads to understand hiring priorities, role requirements, and the specific DNA of candidates who succeed at Monarch, not just on paper, but in our culture.
 



  





**2\. Sourcing \& Outreach** 




 ▸ Develop a direct sourcing engine \- headhunting, industry mapping, passive candidate outreach, alumni networks, conference networking.
 



  





**3\. Screening \& Quality Control** 




 ▸ Implement a rigorous screening process that filters for three things: competence, culture fit, and ownership mindset. Technical skills get you in the door. Attitude determines if you stay.
 



  





**4\. Individual Contribution** 




 ▸ While you lead a small team, you also personally drive the CXO and senior level hiring for the organization to find the right fit leaders for our next phase of growth.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





**Experience :** 
 8\-15 years in talent acquisition, with at least 3 years heading the function.
 **Financial services experience strongly preferred.** 




  





**Industry Understanding :** 
 Must understand the financial services talent landscape \- broking, investment banking, research, compliance, fund management.
 



  





**Sourcing Expertise :** 
 Proven track record of direct sourcing and headhunting for senior/niche roles.
 



  





**Tools :** 
 Proficient in LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, recruitment analytics. Advanced Excel for MIS.
 



  





**Education :** 
 MBA in HR / Postgraduate in Human Resources preferred.
 



  





**Location :** 
 Mumbai

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist \| D2C/E\-commerce** 




**We are an ecommerce company built around a simple promise: “Everyday problems, cleverly solved.”** 




**We’re looking for a hands\-on HR Generalist who can own day\-to\-day HR, drive hiring and build the systems and processes a growing company needs. This role suits someone who enjoys working closely with founders, taking responsibility and turning informal ways of working into clear, practical processes.** 




**What you’ll do** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment: understand team requirements, write job descriptions, source and screen candidates, coordinate interviews and manage offers and joining.
* Hire across marketing, performance marketing, creative, ecommerce, customer support, logistics and operations.
* Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, documentation, probation reviews, confirmations and exits.
* Set up and maintain HR systems for employee records, attendance, leave, reporting and documentation.
* Develop and implement clear company policies, HR SOPs and employee guidelines.
* Run the monthly payroll process, including attendance and leave reconciliation, salary inputs, deductions, reimbursements and payslips, coordinating with the accountant or external advisors as needed.
* Coordinate applicable statutory compliance and maintain accurate supporting records.
* Support managers with performance reviews, employee feedback, accountability and employee concerns.
* Track hiring progress and HR priorities, keeping management informed and following through on pending actions.



**What we’re looking for** 



* Experience across recruitment, HR operations, payroll and employee management.
* Experience in ecommerce, D2C or a fast\-paced consumer business is strongly preferred.
* Experience hiring marketing, creative, logistics or operations teams.
* Ability to independently create and implement HR policies, processes and systems.
* Practical familiarity with HRMS tools, spreadsheets and payroll workflows.
* Strong communication, sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.
* An organised, proactive approach with consistent follow\-through.



**What success looks like** 




**The right people are hired, employees have a smooth onboarding experience, payroll is accurate and timely, records are reliable, and company policies are clear and consistently followed.** 



* **If you enjoy both working with people and building the processes that help a company run well, we’d like to hear from you.**
